concerns.text: FR-009(c) requires Pearson/Spearman between interaction-energy error and viscosity, but plan.md Phase 3 'explicitly excludes' that correlation as scientifically invalid. The tasks' completed-work bullet tags correlate_bulk.py with 'FR-009–FR-011' without stating which correlation pairs were computed, so the excluded FR-009(c) correlation is silently dropped: no task computes it and no task records a spec amendment removing it. Either a task must compute the FR-009(c) correlation or the spec must be amended — as written, the task list claims FR-009 coverage it may not deliver.

SC-005 requires the workflow to complete within 6 hours and ≤7 GB RAM, but T067's verification only records 'commands, exit codes, and artifact checksums'. No task measures or records wall-clock runtime or peak memory, so SC-005 has no evidence-producing step and is silently dropped from the final validation.

T067 validates contract conformance against 'specs/001-transferability-of-dft-d3-dispersion-to-/contracts/', but plan.md places all feature artifacts under 'specs/PROJ-735-transferability-of-dft-d3-dispersion-to-/'. The path mismatch makes the verification step fail or validate the wrong directory; pick one canonical path.

Canonical artifact paths are inconsistent within tasks.md: T065 cites 'data/derived/scaling_factor.txt' while the completed-work section lists bare 'scaling_factor.txt'; T068 mixes 'data/derived/scaling_factor.txt' with unprefixed 'correlation_results.csv'. Fix the paths so verification steps check the files that actually exist.
